name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.101.0 — a mixed pin/promise AC bullet no longer ships silently sanctioned: `lib/spec-sections.js` exports `pinShape(raw)` (`promise` | `pin` | `mixed`, by `SHALL CONTINUE TO` vs bare `SHALL` count) and `normalizeForPinCheck(raw)`, lifted byte-for-byte from `red-check.js`'s own local copy so `red-check.js`, `ac-drift.js`, and the new `ac-matrix.js --lint` mode share one predicate. `red-check.js` refuses a mixed carried AC with a single hard `mixed-pin` finding (the split-the-bullet remedy named, no `unsanctioned-green` attached, and the run exits 1) instead of sanctioning the file green; `ac-matrix.js --lint` runs the AC-line lint alone at `/spec:plan` lock (`malformed-ac`, `invalid-pre-green`, `mixed-pin` as hard findings, zero findings to lock), while the full review-mode matrix prints a mixed bullet as a warning only, never a finding, so `/spec:replay` against older, pre-guard specs stays a fair measurement. `spec-review-driver.js`'s CLOSE step gains one advisory line printing the repo's current AC-pin drift count (`ac-drift.js --json`) after the hygiene listing — informational only, it never touches the verdict, the ledger row, or mark acceptance. 7.100.0 — red-check honours the `[env: VAR]` sanction ac-matrix.js already grants: a red-expected tests file observed green whose EVERY carried AC carries an `[env:]` tag downgrades `unsanctioned-green` to a warning naming each withheld variable, because a host whose testCommand withholds that variable makes the suite skip and `runLeg` (exit codes only) reads green from any shell — the redness is unobservable, not absent. `expected` is never flipped to green by the tag, so a genuinely-red env-gated file (variable provisioned, suite run) still matches its expected colour instead of reporting as `broken-pin`; a file mixing a gated AC with an ungated one still emits `unsanctioned-green`, narrowed to the ACs that actually owe a red with the gated ones named as sanctioned in the detail. The tag counts only when the test file MENTIONS the variable it claims to be gated on, closing the route where `[env: ANY_NAME]` on a vacuous pin would pass the build gate unchallenged (ac-matrix.js's own `[env:]` sanction reconciles SKIPPED tests, so a passing vacuous pin never reaches it). No new finding class, no config/contract change. 7.99.0 — the pre-image is one derivation: base-candidate ORDER moves to `spec/scripts/lib/base-derivation.js` (`pinnedBaseCandidates` -> pin `diff_base` before ref `build_base`) and spec-build-driver.js, spec-review-driver.js and replay.js all import it, each keeping its own validity predicate (build: `merge-base --is-ancestor base HEAD`, NOT the review driver's non-degenerate-range guard, which would refuse every fresh build since base === HEAD at build start; review: resolves + non-degenerate; replay: ancestor-of-parent + distinct); `tests/consistency/base-derivation.test.js` refuses any further private frontmatter read of `build_base` under spec/scripts/, and spec/commands/review.md's prose, which stated the order backwards from its own driver, is corrected. red-attributed's stub-residue guard drops its private `fs.existsSync` predicate for the `changedSinceBase()` one red-check already applies, so a design-landed component committed before the base is no longer called residue (design:true specs stop hand-editing CREATE -> MODIFY), a CREATE row tracked at base WARNs instead of refusing, and a recorded `skipped-resume` red-check skips the residue check with it. Evidence promotion walks a subdirectory under `.claude/spec-runs/` per file instead of throwing ERR_FS_EISDIR after the merge lands, keeping the tracked-restore/untracked-delete decision per path. env-preflight.js gains a direnv scope leg (default mode only): an `.envrc` at --root with DIRENV_DIR naming a different directory exits 1 with the remedy named, DIRENV_DIR unset WARNs, no `.envrc` is a byte-identical no-op.
